Strict Volume Conservation
nodes.rationale: Material is never created or destroyed; authoritative volume calculations are strictly integer microvoxels (8x8x8 = 512 units per block = 1.000 m3).

nodes.label: Compact Bitset Storage
nodes.rationale: 512-bit occupancy bitset (long[8], 64 bytes) plus small per-material composition table keeps occupancy compact while supporting exact mixed proportions.

nodes.label: Lazy World Conversion
nodes.rationale: The world remains vanilla until excavated, deposited into, or deformed, saving memory and eliminating conversion overhead for untouched chunks.

nodes.label: Granular Cobblestone Material
nodes.rationale: Cobblestone produced by crushing stone uses stable 4x4x4 microvoxel visual clusters for coarse rubble.

nodes.label: Chisels & Bits Reference
nodes.rationale: Inspected for sub-block storage, palettes, persistence, versioning, and synchronization under MIT license.

nodes.label: NoCubes Reference
nodes.rationale: Inspected for Surface Nets, Marching Cubes, terrain rendering hooks, custom collisions, and dirty mesh concepts under LGPL-3.0.

nodes.label: LittleTiles Reference
nodes.rationale: Inspected for integer sub-block grids, compact box geometry, merging and partitioning under LGPL-3.0.

nodes.label: Sand Physics Reference
nodes.rationale: Inspected for small physics integration, mixin hooks for falling-block interception under MIT license.

nodes.label: Physics Mod Reference
nodes.rationale: Inspected for verification of Fabric 26.3 custom physics capabilities; classified as BEHAVIOR_ONLY.

nodes.label: Falling Sand Reference
nodes.rationale: Inspected for server-side cellular automaton relaxation without entity spawning; classified as BEHAVIOR_ONLY.

nodes.label: Better Dirt Mining (BDM) Reference
nodes.rationale: Inspected for layer-by-layer mining and partial block terrain interaction UX; classified as BEHAVIOR_ONLY.

nodes.label: Block Layering Reference
nodes.rationale: Inspected for vanilla texture atlas reuse across dynamic granular surfaces; classified as BEHAVIOR_ONLY.

nodes.label: Clean-Room License Audit Policy
nodes.rationale: Strict clean-room implementation policy requiring zero unlicensed code, no decompilation, and recorded license audits for every adaptation.

nodes.label: Integer Volume Authority
nodes.rationale: Floating-point arithmetic is strictly forbidden for authoritative material accounting; 512 units = 1.000 m3.

nodes.label: XZY Microvoxel Indexing Order
nodes.rationale: y is major axis: index = x + 8*(z + 8*y), mapping entire 8x8 horizontal slice to a single 64-bit long.

nodes.label: Material-Aware Excavation Rule
nodes.rationale: Single-material machine containers must pass carried material as filter so foreign materials remain untouched, avoiding lossy rollback.

nodes.label: Continuous Heightfield Meshing Standard
nodes.rationale: Interpolated heightfield fast-path averaging 4 surrounding column heights across block boundaries avoids discrete 8x8x8 steps without heavy isosurface volumes.

nodes.label: Cellular Relaxation Engine Standards
nodes.rationale: Local settling with 32-block downward fall, top-surface ownership, deterministic 8-neighbor slope flow, and strict mass conservation.

nodes.label: Vehicle Physics Standards
nodes.rationale: Universal machine standards: isPickable=true override, maxUpStep=1.25F, self-collision disable, and two-layer WASD fallback.

nodes.label: Strict Server Vehicle Authority
nodes.rationale: Override isClientAuthoritative and isLocalClientAuthoritative to false to prevent client rubberbanding and frozen vehicles.

nodes.label: Excavator Ground Push-Up Physics
nodes.rationale: Boom down-pressure and bucket curling against solid ground jacks undercarriage upward for trench climbing and self-recovery.

nodes.label: 1:1 Kinematic Matrix Synchronization
nodes.rationale: ArmKinematics builds computeBucketMatrix matching ExcavatorRenderer Matrix4f stack with < 0.001 mm error.

nodes.label: Bulldozer Reversing Heap Formation
nodes.rationale: When reversing, moldboard deposits 100% of carried load into a 3-meter-wide 5-column mound marked SIMULATE for natural settling.

nodes.label: Differential Track Steering Physics
nodes.rationale: Counter-rotating tracks on steer input enable in-place pivot, while speed differentials produce curvature driving.

nodes.label: 512x512 Non-Overlapping UV Atlas
nodes.rationale: Master entity textures use 512x512 non-overlapping 2D bin packing across 5 functional rows to eliminate visual distortion.

nodes.label: Volume Conservation Invariant
nodes.rationale: Sum of terrain units plus machine container units equals constant; material is never created or destroyed.

nodes.label: Integer Authority Standard
nodes.rationale: Authoritative volume is strictly measured in integer microvoxels (0..512). Floating point is strictly forbidden for authoritative calculations.

nodes.label: Lazy Conversion Boundary
nodes.rationale: Vanilla blocks remain untouched vanilla blocks until excavated, deposited into, or relaxed into, minimizing memory footprint.

nodes.label: Recount Synchronization Defect
nodes.rationale: Client payload code copied occupancy words and called recount(), which returned count but did not update unitCount, causing client to treat valid terrain as empty.

nodes.label: Premature SIMULATE Flag Clearing Defect
nodes.rationale: GranularWorldStorage.tick() cleared the SIMULATE flag after relaxation, removing requested passes and stopping settling into tall towers.

nodes.label: Deterministic Neighbor Ring Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Replaced Collections.shuffle with hash of worldSeed ^ packedPos ^ revision to eliminate directional bias and ensure repeatable simulation.

nodes.label: Cardinal and Diagonal Repose Thresholds
nodes.rationale: Cardinal threshold uses tan(repose)*8 + cohesion*2; diagonal multiplies by sqrt(2) to account for longer diagonal distance.

nodes.label: Bulk Occupancy Bitset Operations
nodes.rationale: Update complete 64-bit Y layers instead of per-unit bit set/clear calls, optimizing throughput while preserving bottom-fill and top-removal order.

nodes.label: Invisible Block Anchors for Dynamic Collision
nodes.rationale: GranularWorldStorage places invisible GRANULAR_BLOCK anchor for nonempty cells to provide stepped collision, removing them when cells empty.

nodes.label: Bitset Occupancy Model
nodes.rationale: 64-byte occupancy bitset long[8] plus separate composition table separates volume existence from material composition.

nodes.label: XZY Microvoxel Indexing Layout
nodes.rationale: index = x + 8*(z + 8*y) maps each y-slice to a 64-bit long for fast bitwise slice operations and top-down clearing.

nodes.label: Mixed Material Invariant
nodes.rationale: Occupancy answers where volume exists; composition answers what it contains; sum of composition units strictly equals unitCount.

nodes.label: Cobblestone Visual Clustering
nodes.rationale: Cobblestone uses 4x4x4 microvoxel visual clusters for coarse rubble while physical accounting remains on the 8x8x8 microvoxel grid.

nodes.label: Server Networking Authority Model
nodes.rationale: Server owns true state of every microvoxel; client predicts and renders.

nodes.label: Bitset XOR Delta Sync
nodes.rationale: delta = occupancy_new XOR occupancy_old transmits only changed words and bits instead of 64 full bytes.

nodes.label: Per-Tick Simulation Budget
nodes.rationale: Max 64 cells and 1,000 microseconds per tick prevents tick lag or server stutter during large landslides.

nodes.label: Memory Footprint Budget
nodes.rationale: Each GranularCell has ~144 bytes heap overhead; unconverted vanilla terrain consumes 0 additional bytes.

nodes.label: Original Voxel-Box Mesher Limitations
nodes.rationale: Emitted 384 quads per full cell, created step and gray debug artifacts, and lacked textures, normals, and light.

nodes.label: Heightfield Fast-Path Mesher
nodes.rationale: Reads top occupied microvoxels and averages four surrounding column heights at corners across block borders without needing isosurface density fields.

nodes.label: Local Gradient Normal Calculation
nodes.rationale: Computes normal from horizontal gradient difference (left-right, north-south), ensuring matching normals across shared edges.

nodes.label: Vanilla Texture Atlas Reuse
nodes.rationale: Uses vanilla cutout block sprites (dirt, sand, gravel) with planar UV mapping to support player resource packs seamlessly.

nodes.label: Event-Driven Mesh Cache Invalidation
nodes.rationale: Client update invalidates changed cell, 3x3 sampling neighborhood, and cell below, eliminating 18-cell neighborhood hashing every frame.

nodes.label: Single Terrain Renderer Ownership
nodes.rationale: GranularTerrainRenderer made sole terrain path to eliminate duplicate geometry and revision desyncs from GranularBlockEntityRenderer.

nodes.label: Separation of Physics and Visual Geometry
nodes.rationale: Physics/simulation is an 8x8x8 bitset; rendering extracts a smooth continuous surface rather than 512 mini-cubes.

nodes.label: Worker Threading Rendering Architecture
nodes.rationale: CPU mesh extraction on worker thread pool using immutable cell snapshots; GPU upload on main render thread to prevent UI stalls.

nodes.label: Texture Atlas Reuse and Triplanar Mapping
Dirty Region Simulation Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Never scan every granular cell; only modified cells and gradient neighbors enqueue into dirtyQueue with graceful tick-budget degradation.

nodes.label: Material Conservation Invariant
nodes.rationale: Every transfer between cells strictly conserves material: delta is an integer; no material is created or destroyed.

nodes.label: Cellular Automata Angle-of-Repose Relaxation
nodes.rationale: When column height difference exceeds tan(theta)*distance, units slide along steepest gradient toward lower neighbor.

nodes.label: Clean-Room Implementation Policy
nodes.rationale: No unlicensed code, no decompilation, and independent clean-room implementation of algorithms.

nodes.label: Chisels & Bits Audit
nodes.rationale: Studied sub-block indexing and dirty flags; opted for 512-bit bitset instead of multi-state palettes.

nodes.label: NoCubes Audit
nodes.rationale: Studied Surface Nets and decoupling physics storage from visual representation for Stage 3 rendering.

nodes.label: LittleTiles Audit
nodes.rationale: Adopted strict integer microvoxels (512 units/block) to eliminate floating-point drift in simulation.

nodes.label: Sand Physics Audit
nodes.rationale: Learned not to spawn physical entities for granular units; retain cellular grid.

nodes.label: Deterministic Test World Environment
nodes.rationale: Fixed noon, clear weather, force-loaded chunks, spectator camera, and 854x480 resolution ensure repeatable captures.

nodes.label: Numeric Acceptance Invariants
nodes.rationale: Fails unless unit counts are conserved, settled dirty queues reach zero, and piles show radial balance and downhill flow.

nodes.label: API Encapsulation Goals
nodes.rationale: Keep machine mods out of storage internals, allowing machine geometry to operate across block boundaries while preserving integer conservation.

nodes.label: World-Space Terrain Queries
nodes.rationale: Non-mutating queries treat unconverted convertible blocks as full terrain without forcing lazy conversion.

nodes.label: Multi-Cell Spherical Excavation Brush
nodes.rationale: Evaluated in absolute world coordinates, modifying multiple neighboring Groundworks cells in one call.

nodes.label: Material Filtering Rule
nodes.rationale: Non-empty requiredMaterial filter prevents foreign material from mutating, avoiding lossy rollback.

nodes.label: Grading Primitives (Cut and Fill)
nodes.rationale: excavateAbove and fillBelow shave or fill to absolute world-space target heights quantized to 1/8 block microvoxels.

nodes.label: Integer Accounting Invariant
nodes.rationale: Geometry uses floating-point world coordinates, but material accounting strictly returns integer units removed, deposited, and rejected.
